name: Cole Pool Deck
description: The old pool deck was cracked and settling, and water had nowhere to go. We formed and poured a new reinforced concrete deck with the slope set to carry water away from the pool, added a trench drain at the base of the stairs, and rebuilt the stairs with the rise and run corrected so every step is even.
scope: Concrete pool deck, drainage, stairs resurfaced
